meta.title: Chinese Enhancement Suite
meta.description: Comprehensive enhancement plugin with UI polish, layout tweaks, prompt injection, and more.

en.archiveViewDesc: Add an "Archive" button to each workspace row: clicking it hides the group's normal sessions and shows archived session rows inside the official list (scrolls with the list, sorted by most recent activity, 5 by default, 5 more per expand); the row menu has Rename / Fork / Unarchive / Delete, and clicking an archived row restores and opens it
en.autoArchiveDesc: When the New Session view opens, archive sessions inactive for more than the set days (hide from lists only; logs stay). Set 0 to disable this feature
en.batchOpsDesc: Hover the empty leading icon slot of an idle session row to check it; with sessions selected, any row menu offers "Delete selected / Archive selected" (running, pending-interaction and unread-completion rows are not selectable)
en.deleteSessionDesc: Show "Delete session" in the session row menu (log moves to system recycle bin; no restore position); when off, "Delete selected" is hidden from the batch menu too
en.pluginSyncGroupDesc: Copy plugins installed in the other profile (highest version wins)
en.pluginSyncIntro: Copy the plugins installed in the reference profile into the current profile: running in the web app the direction is desktop → web, running in the desktop app it is web → desktop. Packages that already match are skipped, and for the same package only the higher version is kept — if this profile is already at or above the reference it is left alone, never downgraded. Nothing installed here is ever removed. Sync uses the official DSH plugin manager — the same channel as the desktop app sidebar "Plugins" page.
en.pluginSyncNone: Nothing to sync; both sides already match.
en.pluginSyncPartial: Sync finished, but some entries did not fully apply (see status below).
en.pluginSyncPendingBuilds: This package needs its build scripts explicitly allowed to finish installing
en.pluginSyncRouteMissing: Host endpoint not ready: the plugin-sync endpoint is new in this build and needs one restart to become available
en.pluginSyncSkipped: Skipped (this profile is already at or above the reference; never downgraded)
en.promptTextPlaceholder: Type the prompt text to inject…
en.searchApiKeyDesc: Optional. When set, search prefers the Tavily API (1,000 free credits/month, 1 credit per search) and falls back to the keyless engines once exhausted; leave empty to use the keyless engines only. The key is stored in the DSH credentials file (TAVILY_API_KEY in the refs section) and never written into plugin config, logs, or diagnostics snapshots; it takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
en.searchApiKeyEnvNote: Currently provided by an environment variable, which takes precedence over the credentials file; change the environment variable instead — "Clear" has no effect here.
en.searchApiKeyInvalid: Invalid key: must not be empty, must not contain whitespace, and must be at most 512 characters
en.searchApiKeyRouteMissing: Host endpoint not ready: the credentials endpoint is new in this build and needs one dsh web restart to become available (the key itself is fine)
en.searchOrderDesc: Tried top to bottom: a backend that is not installed, unavailable, or fails falls through to the next one, and only a total failure reports an error; a user cancellation never retries. Move DeepSeek Search API to the bottom once it starts billing.
en.searchOrderEmpty: The priority list is empty, so the backend selection is left alone.
en.searchPerQueryDesc: How many sources to keep per query; 0 leaves the official behavior (8 sources, round-robin merge). With N, results are grouped by query — query one N sources, then query two N sources — with cross-query duplicate links dropped. The effective count is also capped by the Search API "Results per search" setting.
en.sectionIntro: Configure UI enhancements, layout and prompt injection.
en.serviceMonitorCardDesc: Watch locally started services and custom entries
en.serviceMonitorDesc: Dual form: keeps the original panel between the session list and Settings in the left sidebar, and adds a "Service monitor" tab in the right sidebar (entry on the guide page); shows local listening services started during the conversation; hover resolves the process on demand and click reveals its location; the tab's "Baseline ports" section lets you bring a baseline port back into monitoring with a click
en.serviceMonitorIntervalDesc: How often the sidebar panel polls the host snapshot; 2-300 seconds
en.serviceMonitorPanelDesc: Keep the service monitor panel visible between the session list and Settings in the left sidebar
en.serviceMonitorTabDesc: Add a "Service monitor" tab to the right sidebar (entry on the guide page)
en.serviceTargetInvalid: Invalid or non-loopback address; use 127.0.0.1:81 / localhost:3000 / [::1]:8080
en.serviceTargetsDesc: Name and address are editable text boxes, change them anytime (Enter or blur saves; invalid addresses are outlined red and not saved); entries stay in the panel permanently: green dot when online, gray dot when offline, hover resolves the listening process, click reveals the process folder
en.thinkingAutoDesc: While thinking streams in, expand the newest output and collapse the previous one (Chinese UI only)
en.thinkMaxLinesDesc: Show only N lines of an expanded thinking block; the rest collapses (reduces UI lag on very long thinking); 0 disables the limit
en.thinkMaxLinesFromDesc: Show the beginning or the end of the thinking by default
en.thinkModeDesc: Button mode: click "expand" to reveal more lines; scroll mode: the folded body gets its own scrollbar, use the mouse wheel to browse
en.zhAgentPromptDesc: Replace the 4 default agents' system prompts with Chinese versions (new sessions only; existing sessions are never re-injected)
en.zhCompleteDesc: Fix leftover English in the Chinese UI and normalize terms/formats
en.zhContextInjectDesc: Replace DSH-injected official context (workspace instructions, skill catalog, runtime context, mode-switch/dynamic-plugin/scheduled-reminder notices, compaction checkpoint) with Chinese before it enters session history (GUI and model requests stay consistent; new sessions only; translating the snapshot header makes DSH inject one replacement snapshot per step, slightly growing the session log)
en.zhPromptDesc: Inject the prompt below into subsequent model requests
en.zhToolDescDesc: Translate the tool descriptions injected into model requests into Chinese (tool names and parameters stay; new sessions only)
en.zhWebSearchDesc: When on, this plugin takes over the web_search backend selection using the "Search backend priority" list below; when off, the backend configured by the deployment stays in place. Multi-engine (keyless DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Bing/Wikipedia plus the optional Tavily API) is one entry in that priority list.
